name: Crown Cap Ventures Ltd.
summary: Crown Cap Ventures Ltd., operating through its subsidiaries, provides a spectrum of internet-based solutions primarily for small and medium-sized businesses across the United States and Canada. Its services include website hosting and support for a diverse range of web applications, such as ASP, ASP.NET 2.0, Linux, Virtual Private Servers (VPS), PHP, SQL Server, MySQL, SharePoint, and Microsoft Exchange. Additionally, the company markets and sells dedicated and managed servers, utilizing both its website and sales teams. Supplemental internet-based offerings and support comprise web design, domain registration, logo creation, search engine optimization (SEO), e-commerce website development, shopping cart software, and Software as a Service (SaaS). For larger organizations, enterprise-level services are also provided, encompassing managed voice solutions, unified messaging, WAN connectivity, co-location, and general internet connectivity. These solutions are primarily disseminated through its online platforms to commercial enterprises and government agencies within the United States and Canada. Formerly known as Areti Web Innovations, Inc., the company rebranded as Crown Cap Ventures Ltd. in October 2021. Founded in 1997, its headquarters are situated in Pahrump, Nevada.
